abstract: Twenty-eight patients cured of testicular cancer by cisplatin-based chemotherapy were asked for their own views of the long-term psychological and social effects of their treatment. Their views were compared with a group of 34 testicular cancer patients cured by radiotherapy who were matched for age, social class and time since treatment. A category rating type questionnaire was used with questions concerning general health, subjective side-effects of treatment, employment, relationships, reproduction and mood. The principal differences were (1) the chemotherapy group reported a greater prevalence of physical side-effects, (2) the radiotherapy group reported greater anxiety and depression since treatment and (3) a significant number of patients in the chemotherapy group felt that their illness had had beneficial effects on their relationships with family and friends.
abstract_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法により精巣がんが治癒した患者28例に、長期的な心理的・社会的影響について自身の見解を尋ねました。これを、年齢・社会階層・治療後経過期間をマッチさせ、放射線療法で治癒した精巣がん患者34例と比較しました。健康状態、治療の主観的副作用、就労、人間関係、生殖、気分を対象とするカテゴリー評価型質問票を用いました。主な違いは次のとおりです。（1）化学療法群では身体的副作用の有病率が高い、（2）放射線療法群では治療後の不安と抑うつが強い、（3）化学療法群の多くが、病気により家族や友人との関係が良くなったと感じている。
